aiSummary.oneLiner: A curated collection of projects created by Chinese independent developers, showcasing indie websites and apps.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository serves as a centralized list of side projects, websites, and applications built by independent developers in China. It provides a platform for indie hackers to share what they are working on, whether for profit, practice, or fun. The main list focuses on ready-to-use products, while sub-boards categorize developer tools and games separately. It actively tracks project status, helping developers discover new tools and network with peers in the indie community.
keyFeatures: Curated product list: Aggregates ready-to-use applications and websites built by Chinese independent developers.
Categorized sub-boards: Separates specialized projects like developer tools and games into distinct markdown files.
Project status tracking: Uses indicators to show if a project is in development, live, or abandoned.
Community contributions: Allows developers to submit their own projects via pull requests or issues.
Historical archives: Maintains archived lists of older projects spanning from 2018 to 2023.
